business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Structural Drafting

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (Unitary National Jurisdiction; Muscat Governorate as administrative and registry center)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (civil-law codification through Royal Decrees; Islamic Sharia as the paramount source of legislation; Anglo-inspired commercial practice in company and financial services matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Oman Free Trade Agreement (Investment Chapter; in force 1 January 2009)
Oman-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 1983)
Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab Countries (Oman party; in force since 1981)
GCC Unified Economic Agreement (ratified by Oman)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: AML/CFT Law promulgated by Royal Decree No. 44/2021 (combating money laundering and the financing of terrorism), as amended; Commercial Companies Law Royal Decree No. 18/2019 and its Executive Regulations Ministerial Decision No. 92/2020; Foreign Capital Investment Law Royal Decree No. 50/2019 with MoCIIP Executive Regulations Decision No. 209/2020; the Financial Intelligence Unit of Oman operates under the AML Law for suspicious transaction reporting and domestic sanctions lists; CBO binding AML/CFT rules apply to licensed financial intermediaries engaged for the target payment rails.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extract of parent company incorporation and constitutional documents (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies / competent notarial authority in the parent company's state of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Oman is a Contracting State to the Apostille Convention effective 1 March 2014); Consular Legalization via the Omani Embassy and the Omani Ministry of Foreign Affairs for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Omani incorporation agent / resident representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or corporate secretary in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of residential address of the founding member, director, and every ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds bank reference letter covering the initial capital and funding of the Omani entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in the country of origin (original bank letterhead, officially signed)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization; departmental bank attestation accepted if the issuing bank refuses notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration on the statutory MoCIIP form, executed before an Omani notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: MoCIIP Commercial Registration Directorate and licensed Omani notaries
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Local Omani notarization and MoCIIP attestation (no apostille required)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD/EDD before registration: screen the founding member, all directors, UBOs and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN, the UN Security Council Consolidated List (Resolutions 1267/1988/1373 and successor regimes), EU/UK Financial Sanctions, the Omani FIU domestic terrorism-financing list, Interpol databases and adverse media; PEP identification (domestic and foreign) extends to family members by blood or marriage and close associates; enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds/source-of-wealth evidence are mandatory for PEPs or where initial capital exceeds OMR 100,000; suspicious transaction reports to the Omani FIU under Royal Decree No. 44/2021; a clean written compliance sign-off is required before incorporation filings are submitted.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Oman Commercial Registry Portal via the MoCIIP integrated e-government business platform (business.gov.om; primary service denominated 'Reserve Trade Name' under the Commercial Registration Directorate)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The primary company name must be in Arabic script and may be accompanied by a vernacular transliteration or English equivalent; the name must carry the legal form suffix for a Single Person Company in Arabic ('شركة الشخص الواحد') or English ('S.P.C.' / 'Single Person Company'); the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to prior registered names, well-known trademarks, or public-entity names; pure acronyms and numerals are not accepted as the distinctive element; orthographic and transliteration consistency is enforced by the Commercial Register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tokens prohibited outright: Sultan, Royal, Royal Court, Diwan, Ministry, Government, Military, Armed Forces, Security, Intelligence, Police, Parliament, Electoral, and any other token implying state patronage, public-order offense, or offense to public morals.

Sensitive tokens requiring prior ministerial or regulatory approval: Oman, National, Gulf, GCC, Arab International, Bank, Finance, Insurance, Islamic, Petroleum, Oil and Gas, Mining, Telecommunications, Airline, Broadcasting, Media.

Misleading token rule: tokens suggesting a licensed activity (banking, insurance, education, pharmaceuticals, hajj and umrah) require the corresponding regulatory license before name clearance; foreign political symbols and company logos are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection the applicant may (1) request a written justification from the MoCIIP Commercial Registration Directorate; (2) file an administrative objection with the Directorate Manager, appending three alternative names, within 10 business days; (3) if denied, lodge a ministerial grievance with the Undersecretary for Commercial Affairs within 30 days from notification; (4) after exhausting administrative remedies, petition the Omani Administrative Court for annulment within 60 days from the final administrative decision; the first objection is free, subsequent filings carry a nominal statutory fee; a conditional name reservation stays its 90-day validity clock pending the objection process.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual, serviced and co-working office addresses are permissible for this low-risk, non-regulated engineering CAD/BIM service activity, provided a physical Omani street address (not a P.O. Box alone) is registered for service of process and mail handling within the Muscat Governorate; the Commercial Register requires documented ownership or lease evidence at incorporation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 15 to 20 percent probability of an unannounced physical inspection by MoCIIP or Muscat Municipality inspectors within the first operating year for a standard low-risk service entity; the probability rises to 40 percent if AML/CFT red flags are triggered or complaints are received by the registry.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman (Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended) — Part II, Chapter 4, provisions governing Single Person Companies; Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) for foreign ownership; Executive Regulations issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registration Department, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), via the Invest Easy one-stop government portal (www.investeasy.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: SPC Memorandum and Articles of Association, filed electronically through Invest Easy together with the Company Incorporation Application and supporting notarized documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SPC under Oman law; the capital amount is fixed in the Memorandum of Association and must be remitted to a licensed Omani commercial bank. For foreign-owned SPCs, the bank issues a capital deposit certificate, and the capital remains credited to the SPC's account and may not be withdrawn to shareholders except on lawful distributions or dissolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the sole shareholder/subscriber hereby subscribes to and accepts all shares of OM_SPC as set forth in the Memorandum of Association, with the agreed registered capital to be funded by lawful foreign remittance. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company at the address specified in the Articles of Association is adopted and approved. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [Full Name] is appointed Chairman and sole manager, and [Full Name] is appointed Secretary, each with full authority to execute the incorporation filings, open bank accounts, and represent the Company. All resolutions are effective immediately, and the officers are each empowered to procure the Commercial Registration Certificate and to commence lawful business operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Invest Easy portal — Companies Registration Department, MoCIIP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Login to Invest Easy, complete the application for reservation of a unique corporate name, and submit 2-3 alternative names in Arabic/English transliteration. Pay the reservation fee electronically and await the automated name-clearance check against existing registered entities and prohibited terms.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Proposed trade name list (Arabic and/or English)
Invest Easy name reservation application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, immediately file a re-submission through Invest Easy with alternative names; any appeal against refusal is submitted as a written request to the Registration Committee stating trademark or goodwill justification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Arabic legal translator / Notary Public and Commercial Advisor recognized by MoCIIP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SPC Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic, specifying the company name, commercial object (ISIC 7110 — engineering and BIM drafting services), registered office address, capital, and governance rules. Have the Arabic original notarized before a notary public and, if required, attested for foreign shareholders.
required_dossiers: Bank capital deposit certificate or pro-forma bank confirmation
Arabic-language Memorandum and Articles of Association (notarized)
Legal translation if source documents are in English
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar returns the M&A for amendment, correct clauses relating to scope or governance and re-execute signatures; notarized amendments are accepted as a restated filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Incorporation Application and Pay Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Invest Easy portal — Companies Registration Department, MoCIIP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized M&A and supporting documents to the incorporation workflow on Invest Easy. File the mandatory declaration for foreign ownership under the Investment Law. Pay the OMR incorporation fee by electronic card or bank transfer and submit for statutory review by the Companies Registration Department.
required_dossiers: Certificate of capital deposit or bank pre-confirmation
Passport copy of shareholder and managers
Foreign ownership declaration under Investment Law
Power of attorney for the local signatory, if applied
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MoCIIP issues a query or request for further information, the applicant has 15 working days to respond through the Invest Easy case inbox; failure to respond leads to abandonment, but the file may be reactivated by paying a nominal penalty and resubmitting the clarifications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Automatic Tax Registration and Social Security Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTax) and General Authority for Social Insurance (PASI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the Commercial Registration certificate, the system automatically allocates a Tax Registration Number (TRN) to the SPC. Confirm TRN in the OTax portal. Register the first employee/manager with PASI for social insurance and execute the employer registration within the statutory 3-day window.
required_dossiers: Passport and residency card of manager/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is not automatically reflected, request manual activation through OTax e-service; any delay in PASI registration is cured by filing a late-registration excuse letter and paying the minimal assessed administrative fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Final Commercial Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Banks licensed by the Central Bank of Oman (e.g. Bank Muscat, NBO, Sohar International)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account in the SPC's name by submitting the CR, M&A, and board resolution. Deposit or confirm the paid-up capital and obtain a capital deposit certificate. In parallel, apply for municipality/office establishment clearance if a physical office is leased, and stamp any employment contracts.
required_dossiers: Office lease or tenancy contract (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence for a non-resident shareholder, provide a notarized source-of-funds declaration and banking references; the account is opened after the compliance review is passed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the SPC's activity is administrative/office-based offshore CAD/BIM drafting, which does not fall under the industrial licensing schedule administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion's Industry Operations Department.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Commercial Registration (CR) — sufficient for conducting engineering CAD/BIM services with no physical industrial plant; no separate operating license is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (EA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is an office-based professional service with no machinery, process wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation; an EIA registration is not required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no industrial discharge, zero process effluent, zero VOC emissions; general office waste is managed under municipal waste collection rules, and disposal of electronic/IT waste must follow e-waste segregation and licensed recycler handoff.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: If a physical office is leased, a fire safety clearance and basic civil defense inspection are required from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA); electrical and structural load certificates for an office fit-out are required by the municipality. For home-office or virtual-office arrangements, no occupational clearance is triggered beyond ordinary office fire-safety compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — unified national tax authority administering Corporate Income Tax (CIT), VAT, and withholding; official e-services portal: taxes.gov.om (tax payer login via OTA user account; registration also accessible through InvestEasy Oman for FDI).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) must first obtain its Commercial Registration (CR) from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion. Then: (1) create a taxpayer profile on taxes.gov.om using the CR number, constitutional deed, and proof of Omani bank account; (2) receive a single 10-digit Tax Identification Number (TIN) valid for CIT, VAT, and withholding; (3) file CIT registration immediately upon commencement of business (no separate license needed for offshore CAD/BIM drafting; a simplified economic substance declaration may apply); (4) register for VAT within 30 days of the date taxable supplies exceed the mandatory threshold; (5) appoint the SPC manager and (if applicable) an OTA-approved tax agent for the electronic filing of returns. The entire registration is paperless and grants access to the VAT e-portal for export zero-rating declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist in Omani law. Available statutory elections: (a) Small Business Relief under the CIT Law — taxable income up to OMR 100,000 is taxed at 0% (the excess is taxed at 15%); (b) VAT voluntary registration election where annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 19,250 but remain below the OMR 38,500 mandatory threshold; (c) VAT tax group registration election for related Omani companies with OTA prior approval; (d) irrevocable election to claim permanent establishment treatment for the SPC's foreign branch, subject to OTA's substance assessment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 38,500 (annual taxable supplies); voluntary registration: OMR 19,250; non-resident suppliers without Oman establishment must register for reverse-charge VAT on Oman B2B supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: OTA has issued an e-invoicing framework and technical specifications with phased implementation. The current mandate for B2B supplies requires an electronic XML invoice integrated with OTA-approved billing software, plus a QR-signed PDF presentation; real-time fiscal clearance is not yet mandatory (expected from late 2025 for Large Taxpayers). Until full clearance, invoices issued under the SPC's Oman VAT number, containing all Article 47 statutory particulars, constitute the fiscal proof. Export zero-rated supplies must be flagged with the zero-rating code and matched to Customs Bayan documentation in the VAT return electronic file.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (a) direct export of goods from Oman to a destination outside the GCC, and (b) export of services supplied to a non-resident recipient who has no place of establishment in Oman, provided the recipient is outside Oman at the time of supply, receives the service abroad, and the service is not directly connected with immovable property situated in Oman. CAD/BIM civil infrastructure drafting, structural modelling, and construction document production supplied electronically to a foreign client qualify as zero-rated exported services when the contract, digital delivery record, and beneficial-use test demonstrate the recipient's foreign location.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayan) with OTA-approved export customs site certificate
Tax invoice bearing the exact zero-rating wording, the SPC's VAT registration number, and the foreign client's name
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (or secure digital delivery certificate for cloud-based BIM files)
Signed service contract (including scope, deliverables, and Incoterms)
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT advice proving receipt of export proceeds
Foreign client's non-residency evidence (overseas VAT/TIN certificate or commercial register extract)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are automatically flag-reviewed by OTA risk engines that cross-match Customs Bayan, foreign exchange inflows, and contract value. Failure to substantiate the export within audit requires the SPC to account for 5% output VAT on the invoice value, plus a deficiency penalty of up to 100% of the tax assessed and default interest at 14% per annum. Deliberate falsification of export evidence constitutes tax evasion under the VAT Law and the Penal Code, carrying fines up to OMR 10,000 and imprisonment of up to three years; the SPC manager and any signatory engineer are jointly liable, and retrospective clawback covers a six-year statutory audit window.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) — exercising sole authority over banking supervision, monetary policy, and foreign exchange administration under the Oman Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000), the Foreign Exchange Policy issued by the CBO, and the Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Financing of Terrorism Law (Royal Decree 30/2016, as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible and freely tradable under IMF Article VIII, with factor market stability anchored by the hard peg of 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD in place since January 1986. Oman maintains complete current-account convertibility; there are no discriminatory exchange restrictions, prior approvals, or surrender requirements for service-related receipts. The capital account is likewise liberalized for foreign direct investment: a 100% foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) may receive equity injections and repatriate dividends and liquidation proceeds without CBO policy authorization, provided the transactions are routed through licensed Omani banks and evidencing documentation (audited profit statements, tax clearance certificates, and the SPC's valid Commercial Registration) is presented to the executing bank. Practically, profit remittance requires the SPC to file statutory financial statements with the Omani Tax Authority, secure a no-objection/tax clearance for the distribution, and settle any applicable withholding tax (generally 0% on dividends under the Oman Corporate Tax Law, subject to the shareholder being a non-resident with no Oman permanent establishment). Main operational hurdles include: (i) all wire transfers must be cleared via a CBO-licensed bank; (ii) the CBO Balance-of-Payments statistical declaration must be filed for each cross-border flow; (iii) bank-side AML review may demand source-of-funds for the injection; and (iv) any deviation from the scheduled business model described in the initial KYC file could trigger enhanced due diligence. Overall convertibility and profit-remittance risk is assessed as LOW.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no mandatory export-proceeds surrender mechanism; the SPC may lawfully retain invoiced proceeds in USD, EUR, or OMR within Oman and is free to convert to OMR at market-determined rates. However, CBO regulations expect all documented commercial revenue derived from services exported (including offshore engineering/BIM deliverables) to be repatriated to the SPC's Omani bank accounts within a reasonable commercial settlement cycle, generally interpreted as within 90 days from the invoice due date. The SPC must record each inbound soft-copy payment against the specific purchase order / master service agreement so that the CBO's electronic Balance-of-Payments reporting and the bank's Transaction Monitoring Unit can reconcile cash flows to the declared business profile. No minimum OMR conversion ratio is prescribed, and holding of foreign currency in the SPC's multi-currency current account is permitted; however, accumulation of unrepatriated offshore balances over a prolonged period may trigger a bank-level review of the entity's economic substance in Oman.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (non-interest bearing, clearly earmarked for FDI injection) + multi-currency Operational Current Account in OMR/USD/EUR with Cash Management API
Operational Current Account with direct global connectivity to the HSBC group's correspondent network (ideal for USD/GBP/EUR trade settlements and parent-subsidiary treasury integration)
Operational Current Account with dedicated corporate trade finance and cash management desk
Operational Account for payroll, local vendor disbursements, retention escrow and overhead management
Operational and Escrow Accounts with digitally-enabled onboarding for SME and professional services entities

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Oman Arab Bank SAOG (including the merged Alizz Islamic banking window)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account — acceptable as a fallback secondary banking channel only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM (auxiliary only). Wise (formerly TransferWise) is operationally usable in Oman as a regulated remittance corridor for low-value inbound and outbound transfers: it supports OMR receipt into the SPC's local account via Oman's local clearing rails and can execute cross-border payments to the SPC's foreign BIM subcontractors and software vendors. Wise is NOT a CBO-licensed bank and therefore cannot serve as the SPC's primary statutory treasury account, escrow account, or the sole cash-management platform; all material cross-border receipts and all capital movements must first land in an account at a CBO-licensed commercial bank. Other offshore digital EMIs (Revolut Business, Mercury, Airwallex, Payoneer) have no licensing or physical presence in Oman, and Omani corporate account-opening regulations effectively prohibit a foreign-owned SPC from routing its operating revenue through any non-CBO-licensed institution. Recommended architecture: use the licensed Omani bank as the legal and financial settlement spine; use Wise only for sub-threshold (under OMR 5,000 per transaction) operational disbursements with full invoice references retained for audit and CBO reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatorily required for the first-time onboarding of a wholly foreign-owned SPC. A face-to-face interview must be conducted at the chosen bank's Muscat/head-office branch or designated corporate centre for at least one of the following: the SPC's registered manager or a director/authorized signatory with board-level authority. Remote video-KYC is accepted by some banks (Bank Muscat and HSBC Oman) only for additional signatories once the corporate relationship is active, and only where the UBO or primary principal has completed an in-person identity verification at an overseas HSBC group branch or via a notarized power-of-attorney holder physically present in Oman. In practice, the foreign owner must either commit a 2-3 business-day trip to Muscat to sign account mandates and undergo compliance interviews, or appoint a locally-resident Omani agent who appears in person on behalf of the SPC with a notarized, apostilled, and Arabic-translated general power of attorney. A credible alternative adopted by HSBC Oman is remote onboarding using the parent's existing HSBC Premier/Corporate relationship in the shareholder's home jurisdiction, mirroring identity and source-of-funds checks across the group without eliminating the need for a formal Omani account signatory visit for the final activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% foreign ownership with the UBO residing outside Oman and no visible operational footprint in the country
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit: (i) certificate of incorporation and constitutional documents of the parent entity; (ii) Oman Commercial Registration and the single-person company contract registered with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) via Invest Easy; (iii) a 12-month Muscat serviced-office agreement under the SPC's name; (iv) audited financial statements of the parent for the final two fiscal years; (v) the UBO's passport and residence-permit copy; (vi) a source-of-funds and source-of-wealth declaration joined to home-jurisdiction tax returns and two years of bank statements; and (vii) an explainable operating model letter referencing the specific ISIC 7110 BIM/CAD outsourcing contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business narrative mismatch — a pure digital services entity with no import/export of physical goods, raising red flags on the purpose of a full Oman treasury presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide executed master service agreements with named counterparties in the GCC/UK/EU; BIM software license lists (Autodesk, Bentley, Nemetschek, Graphisoft) with current subscription invoices; a professional indemnity insurance certificate; a forecast 12-month cash-flow statement stamped by a certified public accountant in the shareholder's jurisdiction; and an operational process map showing where CAD deliverables are produced, quality-checked, and delivered digitally to clients.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound FDI capital injection exceeding OMR 250,000 without satisfactory evidence of the underlying foreign investment approval
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Obtain and present: (i) the capital category registration in the Invest Easy / MoCIIP investment file; (ii) the SPC board resolution authorizing equity capital contribution; (iii) a parent-company capital call letter referencing the registered capital amount; (iv) a source-of-funds letter from the parent's home bank with two years of statements evidencing earnings; and (v) a capital escrow instruction designating the exact account at Bank Muscat or HSBC Oman to which the MT103 wire will be directed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Elevated transaction velocity or large round-trip flows in the first 90 days of account opening, including transfers to offshore personal accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Adopt and submit a board-approved treasury policy confirming: (i) every outbound payment must be tied to an executed sub-contractor invoice or payroll record; (ii) personal-account transfers are strictly prohibited; (iii) vendor payments above OMR 10,000 require a second-approver mandate; and (iv) all counterparties undergo a simplified due-diligence check for sanctions and PEP status. Present the policy at onboarding, and reconcile monthly with a bank-statement mapping report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdictional risk flag arising from the UBO's nationality or tax residence on a FATF watch-list or sanctions-adjacent registry
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commission an independent sanctions and negative-news screening report (Refinitiv / Oracle / Moody's) showing clean results; provide proof of current permanent residence in a non-flagged jurisdiction; present the UBO's employment or business-owner track record in the engineering sector; and submit a signed rectification letter explaining the country linkage, supported by a real commercial nexus to GCC infrastructure projects.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound FDI equity injections must be wired via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202/COVER for intermediate correspondent routing) from the parent entity's corporate bank to the designated Capital Escrow Account at Bank Muscat or HSBC Oman, ensuring the remittance information (field 70) reads: 'FDI CAPITAL INJECTION — OM_SPC — COMMERCIAL REGISTRATION [CR NUMBER] — ISIC 7110 ENGINEERING/BIM SERVICES — INVEST EASY CAPITAL REF [REF]'. Where the remitting bank applies formal ISO 20022 purpose classification, use the OECD/ECB BOP-code equivalent for 'Direct Investment — Equity Capital' (e.g., P0007 / N512 under the SWIFT category set, or the home-jurisdiction equivalent) to avoid misclassification as ordinary trade payments. The SPC must present the MoCIIP capital settlement certificate and the bank's credit advice for the CBO Balance-of-Payments filing within two business days. For injections above OMR 250,000, the receiving bank will require the end-use undertaking, a source-of-wealth memorandum, and the parent's audited statements; funds must be sourced strictly from the named parent entity — third-party funding without a notarized subordination/deed of contribution is rejected.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational liquidity outflows (subcontractor fees, BIM software subscriptions, cloud infrastructure, payroll, rent) clear via SWIFT MT103 for foreign-currency payments and via Oman's real-time gross settlement (RTGS/OmanNet) for local OMR transfers. Recommended routing tiers: (i) sub-threshold payments under OMR 10,000 — executed via the bank's corporate internet-banking API (single file ISO 20022 pain.001) with invoice imprints; (ii) medium-value payments of OMR 10,000–100,000 — routed through the bank's cash-management desk with pre-vetted beneficiary files to expedite MT103 release; (iii) large-value settlements above OMR 100,000 for procurement of mission-critical infrastructure or where the counterparty demands guaranteed settlement — use an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit (LC at sight or 60 days tenor) issued under the SPC's trade line, covering deliverables described as 'Building Information Modeling (BIM) software licenses, structural drafting services, and cloud computing infrastructure', with all transport docs replaced by delivery and acceptance certificates given the digital nature of the supply. Same-day clearing is available within the GCC via the GCC-SCGS and regional correspondent links; UK/EU/US payments typically settle T+2 via the banks' correspondent corridors. Wise may be used strictly as a supplementary low-value rail for payments below OMR 5,000, provided the same beneficiary due-diligence and invoice-reference retention requirements are applied.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Outright Forwards (USD/OMR, EUR/OMR, GBP/OMR) transacted with CBO-licensed commercial banks only; these constitute the standard hedging vehicle given the OMR/USD hard peg and are available for commitment-driven exposures arising from BIM project contracts denominated in EUR, GBP, or USD.

FX Swaps (spot-forward combination) for short-cycle treasury mismatches, such as aligning USD receipts into OMR payroll funding dates, entered under an ISDA Master Agreement or the bank's standard FX master.

Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS) between USD/OMR and EUR for the tenor of any structured project-finance liabilities linked to GCC civil-infrastructure delivery, conditional on hedge-strategy approval by the SPC's internal treasury risk committee and periodic CBO/BOP reporting.

Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (CCIRS) — permissible only where the notional is matched to an underlying borrowing or investment asset; speculative interest-rate positions are prohibited by standard CBO policy.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) in OMR — NOT permissible and commercially unnecessary because the OMR/USD is officially pegged and a fully deliverable OMR forward market operates within the licensed banking system; any attempted NDF booking on OMR would be rejected by the CBO as outside the sanctioned product scope.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), Commercial Registry Department, Muscat
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the annual anniversary of the Commercial Registration Certificate issuance date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of OMR 10 (USD 26) per week of delay; suspension of commercial registration after 45 days; administrative strike-off after 6 consecutive months of unresolved renewal status via MOCIIP e-portal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOCIIP, Corporate Affairs and Companies Control Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the date falling six months after the fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end the deadline is 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to OMR 1,000 (USD 2,600) under the Omani Companies Law; repeated non-filing for two consecutive accounting periods leads to administrative strike-off and loss of good-standing certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOCIIP e-Services Portal, Beneficial Ownership Register Section, Muscat
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March, covering the final calendar year position unless a share transfer or UBO change occurs earlier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty of OMR 500 (USD 1,300) per overdue confirmation; suspension of electronic certificate access until compliance; potential disqualification measures under AML/CFT procedures.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit is compulsory for all Omani companies, including Single Person Companies (SPC), irrespective of turnover, assets or headcount. The appointed auditor must be independent and registered with the Oman Association of Accountants and Auditors (OAAA).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Oman; supporting local GAAP reconciliation schedules are customary where a foreign sole shareholder applies a different national GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Single Person Company must update the UBO register within 15 days of any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership. Concurrently, an annual UBO confirmation must be submitted to MOCIIP each calendar year; this confirmation attests the continuing accuracy of the previously registered sole shareholder. Failure to confirm causes suspension of MOCIIP electronic credential access and monetary fines.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of sole shareholder resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential 3% rate for taxable income not exceeding OMR 100,000; 0% withholding tax on dividends; exemption available for qualifying reinvestment and treaty-protected profits; capital gains on securities disposal may be exempt where not part of a trade. No statutory tax holiday boutique regime is available for CAD/BIM outsourcing services.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Oman Tax Authority CIT Annual Return via Oman Tax Portal / Sanad-plus electronic filing system (taxoman.gov.om)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four calendar months following the fiscal year-end; a company with a 31 December year-end must file on or before 30 April of the following year. Extension requests may be made through the Tax Portal before the statutory deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer registration number (SANAD ID) and legal entity identity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Omani SPC SANAD ID; the foreign parent shareholder is not substituted as the filing entity unless it has a separate Oman permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year covered, stated from day one to year-end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a foreign-owned Omani SPC, the reporting period must match the audited financial statements and the Tax Portal registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal activity and ISIC code; for this dossier, ISIC 7110 with commercial model description 'Civil Infrastructure CAD and BIM drafting services'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident acting through an Oman PE must describe the Oman-source engineering/drafting services separately from offshore head-office work.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Audited financial statements upload and accounting-basis declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Audited statements are required for SPCs above Oman statutory thresholds; non-resident PEs must include a PE income statement and allocation schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue and other operating income from the profit and loss statement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all Omani civil infrastructure BIM/CAD taxable revenue; foreign-currency receipts must be declared in OMR using the applicable Tax Authority exchange rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses attributable to Omani engineering/CAD activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only expenses directly incurred for production of Omani taxable income; head-office administrative charges are deductible only when supporting transfer pricing documentation exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-backs of non-deductible expenses, including unreasonable repairs, statutory penalties, bribes, excess entertainment, and transfer pricing adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses not satisfying the economic-benefit test are added back for a non-resident PE; management fees to foreign affiliates must meet the arm's-length standard.
Only items expressly exempt under Oman domestic law or a double tax treaty, such as qualifying dividends or treaty-protected capital gains, are recorded here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting profit before tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an Oman PE, net profit is computed from the audited Oman PE financial statements after allocation of shared expenses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carryforward offset; maximum five-year vintage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must claim losses specifically attributable to the Oman PE and cannot apply foreign head-office losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after all adjustments, loss offset, and exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The taxable income must be clearly allocated to the Omani engineering services rendered; no other Oman-source income is merged.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable corporate income tax rate and tentative tax computation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 15% as the statutory rate; the 3% preferential rate is applied only when taxable income does not exceed OMR 100,000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, advance payments, and withholding tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits are available under tax treaties only when the DTA residence certificate and supporting withholding evidence are attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of corporate tax payable or refund due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the balance through Oman Tax Authority e-payment; non-resident PE remittances of after-tax profits have no additional Omani dividend withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Transfer pricing disclosure: aggregate value of controlled cross-border and domestic transactions and method applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-owned SPC must state which arm's-length methodology supports purchases/resales of engineering services and any related-party software licensing.
The signatory must be a locally declared officer; the foreign shareholder cannot act as sole signatory unless properly appointed as a director/manager.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of OMR 100 per month or part month up to a statutory maximum; late payment surcharge of 1% per month on the unpaid corporate income tax balance, capped at 25%; defective/fraudulent filing triggers additional discretionary penalties up to 50% of the underpaid tax and, in evasion cases, criminal fines up to OMR 25,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Oman does not impose statutory withholding tax on dividends paid by an Omani SPC to any shareholder, including a foreign parent).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because no Omani dividend withholding tax is levied, no treaty-relief filing is required for ordinary share distributions. If a treaty-based reduction is sought for any future withholding tax or for Omani-source royalties, the beneficial owner must submit a DTA relief application through the Oman Tax Portal before the payment is processed, attaching the current-year Certificate of Tax Residence issued by the foreign tax authority, a beneficial ownership statement, and the underlying service/royalty agreement. The Omani payor is the withholding agent and must retain the approved relief letter for audit.

stage_6.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory 10% withholding on payments to a non-resident for royalties, technical fees, and services performed in Oman; treaty rates for royalties are generally capped at 8% under many updated Oman DTAs. Interest paid to non-resident lenders is not subject to statutory Omani withholding tax, but becomes taxable if the lender carries on business in Oman through a permanent establishment or the interest is effectively connected to an Oman fixed base.
